items.title: 52043_Herman Autrey oral history interview
items.q: I finally met them and knew them personally, and played for them... I played for all of them.

ctx.x: But I mean before you arrived in Pittsburgh, and got your trumpet, did you get a chance to hear any jazz?

Yes. I had records of Mamie Smith, 'Yellow Hound Dog,' and whatnot, and that stuff. You know. I usually didn't have the -- I had the records, and what, Bessie Smith, Mamie Smith, and I started running to all that, and I finally met them and knew them personally, and played for them, and that was a thrill. Yeah.
